vulnerability.name: USN-5942-2
vulnerability.description: USN-5942-1 fixed vulnerabilities in Apache HTTP Server. This update provides the corresponding update for CVE-2023-25690 for Ubuntu 16.04 ESM.  Original advisory details:   Lars Krapf discovered that the Apache HTTP Server mod_proxy module  incorrectly handled certain configurations. A remote attacker could  possibly use this issue to perform an HTTP Request Smuggling attack.  (CVE-2023-25690)

statements.status_notes: Apache HTTP Server could allow unintended access to network services. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
